entries.root_cause: openbb-mcp is declared at rank 10 with no region scope, so it wins income_statement/balance_sheet/cash_flow (and is tried first for IN fundamentals); its _normalize_symbol only swaps '.'->'-' and forwards the bare ticker to OpenBB's yfinance backend, which answers with the US listing. get_income_statement/get_balance_sheet/get_cash_flow run with validate=None (no identity/currency/scale gate), so the wrong entity's well-formed rows are served and the yfinance lane that would map to <sym>.BO is never reached. /fundamentals escapes only via its screener-completeness acceptor, and even there the all-null-shell guard ignores `name`, so SUMAX returns a US fund's name. The same normalizer mangles RELIANCE.NS -> RELIANCE-NS (a guaranteed-failing MCP round trip on every IN fundamentals request).
entries.fix_shape: Give openbb-mcp an explicit region scope (US/GLOBAL only) or route its symbol through yfinance_provider._yahoo_symbol (region-aware .NS/.BO, preserve trailing exchange suffixes), and give the three statement accessors the same identity validator /fundamentals has (symbol/name/currency/share-count order-of-magnitude vs the resolved instrument; count `name` as identity in the all-null-shell guard). Pin with a parametrised test over the battery collision set (DAL, CHTR, SAFE, CSL, ICON, AMAL, SMR, TTC, SUMAX) asserting statements come back .BO/INR for an IN session, plus a RELIANCE.NS normalizer case.

entries.title: Backtest 'Sortino' is not the Sortino ratio: the denominator is the stdev of the loss subset, overstating it 41x on a plausible series and reading 0.00 when losses are identical or single

Pin the accounting with a unit test feeding a drifted-markup page and asserting the breaker counts a failure.
